teaser: When did you last take something apart just to see what was actually wrong with it? You are a 7, built for questions, and an ISTP, built for hands. The 7 wants the hidden mechanism behind the visible world; the ISTP wants the mechanism itself, in pieces on a table. Where the two cross, the search for truth stops being a thought and becomes a thing to be field-tested. You do not sit with a mystery so much as strip it down to its screws, and the stripping down is the thinking.
